name: trusted-delivery

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "**"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    name: verify
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'RGCsAGupta/driftlens' &&
      github.actor == github.repository_owner
    runs-on:
      - self-hosted
      - Linux
      - X64
      - driftlens-ci
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out the pushed revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: 24.15.0

      - name: Verify delivery policy
        run: >-
          node --test
          tests/workflow-policy.test.mjs
          tests/deployment-policy.test.mjs

      - name: Check target script syntax
        run: sh -n ops/deployment/v1/*.sh

      - name: Cache npm downloads
        if: hashFiles('package-lock.json') != ''
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}

      - name: Install application dependencies
        if: hashFiles('package-lock.json') != ''
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run application quality gates
        if: hashFiles('package-lock.json') != ''
        run: npm run verify

      - name: Require the application foundation on main
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && hashFiles('package-lock.json') == ''
        run: |
          echo "Application foundation missing; main release blocked." >&2
          exit 1

  release:
    name: private-release
    needs:
      - verify
    if: >-
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      github.repository == 'RGCsAGupta/driftlens' &&
      github.actor == github.repository_owner
    runs-on:
      - self-hosted
      - Linux
      - X64
      - driftlens-deploy
    timeout-minutes: 30
    environment:
      name: private-demo
    concurrency:
      group: driftlens-private-deployment
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - name: Check out the verified revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Validate and mask release inputs
        env:
          DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_DEPLOY_HOST }}
          DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS }}
          DEPLOY_SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}
          DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_DEPLOY_USER }}
          REGISTRY: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY }}
          REGISTRY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
          REGISTRY_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          for value in \
            "$DEPLOY_HOST" \
            "$DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS" \
            "$DEPLOY_SSH_KEY" \
            "$DEPLOY_USER" \
            "$REGISTRY" \
            "$REGISTRY_PASSWORD" \
            "$REGISTRY_USERNAME"
          do
            test -n "$value"
          done
          printf '%s' "$GITHUB_SHA" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'
          printf '%s' "$DEPLOY_USER" | grep -Eq '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]*$'
          printf '%s' "$DEPLOY_HOST" | grep -Eq '^([A-Za-z0-9.-]+|\[[0-9A-Fa-f:]+\])$'
          printf '%s' "$REGISTRY" |
            grep -Eq '^([A-Za-z0-9.-]+|\[[0-9A-Fa-f:]+\])(:[0-9]{1,5})?$'
          printf '%s' "$REGISTRY_USERNAME" |
            grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9._@-]+$'
          if printf '%s' "$REGISTRY_PASSWORD" |
            LC_ALL=C grep -q '[[:cntrl:]]'
          then
            echo "Registry password contains unsupported control characters." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          test "${REGISTRY#http://}" = "$REGISTRY"
          test "${REGISTRY#https://}" = "$REGISTRY"
          for value in \
            "$DEPLOY_HOST" \
            "$DEPLOY_USER" \
            "$REGISTRY" \
            "$REGISTRY_USERNAME"
          do
            echo "::add-mask::$value"
          done

      - name: Build and publish immutable image
        id: publish
        env:
          DOCKER_CONFIG: ${{ runner.temp }}/driftlens-docker-config
          REGISTRY: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY }}
          REGISTRY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
          REGISTRY_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          install -m 0700 -d "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
          image_tag="${REGISTRY%/}/driftlens:${GITHUB_SHA}"
          echo "::add-mask::$image_tag"
          printf '%s' "$REGISTRY_PASSWORD" |
            docker login "$REGISTRY" --username "$REGISTRY_USERNAME" --password-stdin
          docker build \
            --build-arg "DRIFTLENS_BUILD_SHA=$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --tag "$image_tag" \
            .
          docker push "$image_tag"
          repository="${REGISTRY%/}/driftlens"
          image_digest=""
          while IFS= read -r candidate
          do
            if test "${candidate%%@*}" = "$repository"; then
              test -z "$image_digest"
              image_digest="$candidate"
            fi
          done <<EOF
          $(docker image inspect "$image_tag" --format '{{range .RepoDigests}}{{println .}}{{end}}')
          EOF
          printf '%s' "$image_digest" | grep -Eq '@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
          echo "::add-mask::$image_digest"
          printf 'image_tag=%s\n' "$image_tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'image_digest=%s\n' "$image_digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Configure pinned SSH trust
        env:
          DEPLOY_HOST: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_DEPLOY_HOST }}
          DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS }}
          DEPLOY_SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}
          DEPLOY_USER: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_DEPLOY_USER }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          install -m 0700 -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh"
          printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_SSH_KEY" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/key"
          printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/known_hosts"
          chmod 0600 \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/key" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/known_hosts"
          ssh-keygen -l -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/key" >/dev/null
          ssh-keygen -F "$DEPLOY_HOST" -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/known_hosts" >/dev/null
          {
            echo "Host driftlens-target"
            printf '  HostName %s\n' "$DEPLOY_HOST"
            printf '  User %s\n' "$DEPLOY_USER"
            echo "  BatchMode yes"
            echo "  ConnectTimeout 10"
            echo "  IdentitiesOnly yes"
            echo "  LogLevel ERROR"
            echo "  StrictHostKeyChecking yes"
            echo "  IdentityFile $RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/key"
            echo "  UserKnownHostsFile $RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/known_hosts"
          } > "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/config"
          chmod 0600 "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/config"

      - name: Deploy exact digest with transient target registry authentication
        env:
          IMAGE_DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.image_digest }}
          REGISTRY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
          REGISTRY_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          {
            printf '%s\n' "$REGISTRY_USERNAME"
            printf '%s\n' "$REGISTRY_PASSWORD"
          } |
            ssh -F "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/config" driftlens-target \
              sudo --non-interactive /usr/local/sbin/driftlens-release \
                "$IMAGE_DIGEST" \
                "$GITHUB_SHA"

      - name: Verify private health, readiness, and version
        run: |
          set -eu
          ssh -F "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/config" driftlens-target \
            sudo --non-interactive /usr/local/sbin/driftlens-smoke \
              "$GITHUB_SHA"

      - name: Remove transient release material
        if: always()
        env:
          DOCKER_CONFIG: ${{ runner.temp }}/driftlens-docker-config
          IMAGE_DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.image_digest }}
          IMAGE_TAG: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.image_tag }}
          REGISTRY: ${{ secrets.DRIFTLENS_REGISTRY }}
        run: |
          docker logout "$REGISTRY" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          docker image rm "$IMAGE_DIGEST" "$IMAGE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          rm -f "$DOCKER_CONFIG/config.json"
          rmdir "$DOCKER_CONFIG" 2>/dev/null || true
          rm -f \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/config" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/key" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh/known_hosts"
          rmdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/driftlens-ssh" 2>/dev/null || true

   316	  bypass Cloudflare protection.
   317	
   318	The delivery specification verifies the dedicated topology and existing
   319	configuration before reuse. Another host or identity, registry change,
   320	Cloudflare account, domain route, access policy, or broader permission remains
   321	a new user decision.
   322	
   323	## 9. Security and trust boundaries
   324	
   325	### Product runtime
   326	
   327	- Validate every API, configuration, manifest, and external response boundary.
   328	- Keep secrets in runtime configuration only.
   329	- Mask sensitive values in structured logs and errors.
   330	- Mount kubeconfig and deployment credentials read-only where possible.
   331	- Use least-privilege Kubernetes RBAC.
   332	- Restrict GitHub source identity and transport.
   333	- Never mutate Kubernetes.
   334	- Never expose the local origin publicly without the approved external access
   335	  boundary.
   336	
   337	Core has no application-managed authentication or authorization. Local mode
   338	relies on operator-controlled network placement; hosted access reuses the
   339	existing Cloudflare protection.
   340	
   341	### GitHub Actions
   342	
   343	This public repository uses self-hosted environments under a strict trust
   344	model:
   345	
   346	| Event | Self-hosted CI | Deployment access |
   347	| --- | --- | --- |
   348	| Push to canonical trusted issue branch | Allowed | None |
   349	| User-approved merge push to protected `main` | Full gates | Least-privilege demo deployment |
   350	| Fork or external pull-request event | Forbidden | Forbidden |
   351	| Comment or `pull_request_target` event | Forbidden | Forbidden |
   352	
   353	Workflows use canonical-repository `push` events only. External changes must be
   354	reviewed and copied into a trusted canonical branch before any execution.
   355	Workflow tokens are read-only by default, third-party Actions are pinned to
   356	immutable SHAs, and runner labels are not treated as a security boundary.
   357	
   358	CI and deployment need separate runner instances or isolated execution
   359	identities. CI must not have a deployment kubeconfig, Cloudflare credential,
   360	or broad home-lab access. The deployment identity accepts protected `main`
   361	pushes only.
   362	
   363	One workflow provides the delivery DAG:
   364	
   365	1. every trusted canonical branch push runs the verify job;
   366	2. the same `main` run continues to build one immutable SHA-tagged artifact;
   367	3. deployment waits for verify and build, then uses the isolated deployment
   368	   identity; and
   369	4. smoke verification proves the exact deployed revision.
   370	
   371	A single deployment concurrency group queues main revisions rather than
   372	cancelling an in-progress deployment. A second workflow must not duplicate the
   373	full verification or build.
   374	
   375	## 10. Observability and failure handling
   376	
   377	- Structured logs use levels and include scan and request correlation IDs.
   378	- Logs record stage transitions and error classes, never secret values or full
   379	  manifests.
   380	- Health reports process availability.
   381	- Readiness verifies required configuration and writable persistence without
   382	  depending on GitHub, Kubernetes, or OpenAI being continuously available.
   383	- API errors contain a stable machine-readable code and actionable safe
   384	  message.
   385	- Adapter failures are classified separately from comparison outcomes.
   386	
   387	Core stores enough state for the operator to understand a failed scan. It does
   388	not promise recovery of active work after process restart.

     1	# DriftLens
     2	
     3	DriftLens is a focused operator tool for comparing the desired state of one
     4	Kubernetes `apps/v1` Deployment with its live cluster state. The current API
     5	starts one read-only scan, exposes persisted progress and history, and reports
     6	exact replica and regular-container image differences.
     7	
     8	## Prerequisites
     9	
    10	- Node.js `24.15.0`
    11	- npm `11`
    12	- Docker for the production-container check
    13	
    14	## Local setup
    15	
    16	```bash
    17	export DRIFTLENS_GITHUB_REPOSITORY=owner/public-repository
    18	export DRIFTLENS_MANIFEST_PATH=path/to/deployment.yaml
    19	export DRIFTLENS_KUBECONFIG_PATH=/absolute/path/to/read-only.kubeconfig
    20	# Optional: export DRIFTLENS_KUBECONTEXT=explicit-context
    21	
    22	npm ci
    23	npm run dev
    24	```
    25	
    26	Open `http://localhost:3000`.
    27	
    28	The configured GitHub repository must be public. The manifest path must be a
    29	safe relative path to one plain-YAML `apps/v1` Deployment with explicit
    30	`metadata.name` and `metadata.namespace`. The kubeconfig identity must have
    31	only the namespaced Deployment `get` permission needed for the target.
    32	
    33	## Scan API
    34	
    35	The formal, machine-readable contract for these routes is
    36	[OpenAPI 3.1](docs/openapi.yaml). It also records the current authentication
    37	and exposure boundary.
    38	
    39	| Endpoint             | Success | Purpose                                      |
    40	| -------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------- |
    41	| `GET /api/source`    | `200`   | Non-secret repository and manifest metadata  |
    42	| `POST /api/scans`    | `202`   | Persist and schedule one scan                |
    43	| `GET /api/scans`     | `200`   | Newest-first history, default 20, maximum 50 |
    44	| `GET /api/scans/:id` | `200`   | Status, stages, target, result, safe failure |
    45	
    46	Start and poll a scan:
    47	
    48	```bash
    49	curl --fail-with-body \
    50	  --request POST \
    51	  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
    52	  --data '{"ref":"main"}' \
    53	  http://localhost:3000/api/scans
    54	
    55	curl --fail-with-body http://localhost:3000/api/scans/SCAN_ID
    56	curl --fail-with-body 'http://localhost:3000/api/scans?limit=20'
    57	```
    58	
    59	The request accepts one branch or commit SHA. DriftLens resolves the input
    60	through the GitHub commits API and records the immutable 40-character SHA
    61	before reading the configured file at that exact revision. A second start
    62	while one in-process scan is active returns `409 SCAN_ACTIVE` without creating
    63	another scan.
    64	
    65	Stages are `QUEUED`, `LOADING_DESIRED`, `READING_LIVE`, `COMPARING`,
    66	`SAVING_RESULT`, then `COMPLETED` or `FAILED`. Execution status is
    67	`QUEUED`, `RUNNING`, `COMPLETED`, or `FAILED`.
    68	
    69	### Comparison semantics
    70	
    71	- Omitted desired replicas default to `1`.
    72	- Desired regular containers match live regular containers by name.
    73	- Image strings compare exactly.
    74	- Missing desired containers report drift with a `null` live value.
    75	- Extra live-only containers are ignored.
    76	- Init, ephemeral, runtime-owned, and unrelated fields are ignored.
    77	- Results are only `IN_SYNC`, `DRIFTED`, or `MISSING_LIVE`.
    78	
    79	Git, manifest, Kubernetes authorization/availability, transport timeout, and
    80	storage failures are execution errors, never drift. Public errors use stable
    81	codes and safe messages without upstream bodies, credentials, kubeconfig
    82	content, or complete manifests.
    83	
    84	## Persistence
    85	
    86	`DRIFTLENS_DATA_DIR` contains `driftlens.sqlite`. Node 24 `node:sqlite`
    87	bootstraps schema version 1 idempotently and uses prepared statements for every
    88	dynamic value. The database retains only requested/resolved revisions,
    89	supported projections and differences, target identity, timestamps, stages,
    90	outcomes, and safe errors. It never stores complete manifests or kubeconfig
    91	content.
    92	
    93	One process owns one SQLite connection and one in-memory active-scan marker.
    94	Restart preserves existing history but clears the marker. Stale `QUEUED` or
    95	`RUNNING` records remain unchanged as evidence; Core does not resume, repair,
    96	or delete them. If a later history write fails, the current process exposes a
    97	non-durable safe storage failure without claiming that terminal state was
    98	persisted. Non-durable terminal overlays are bounded; if that bound is
    99	exceeded, new scans, history, and readiness fail closed with
   100	`STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` rather than exposing an older durable state as current
   101	truth.
   102	
   103	Structured scan logs contain only a generated scan identifier, stage or safe
   104	error code, severity, and durability flag. They exclude refs, repository paths,
   105	manifest content, kubeconfig data, credentials, and upstream error bodies.
   106	
   107	## Operational endpoints
   108	
   109	| Endpoint           | Success        | Purpose                                                |
   110	| ------------------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
   111	| `GET /api/health`  | `200`          | Process liveness independent of external configuration |
   112	| `GET /api/ready`   | `200` or `503` | Configuration readiness with safe issue codes          |
   113	| `GET /api/version` | `200`          | Embedded build commit SHA                              |
   114	
   115	Successful responses use these stable shapes:
   116	
   117	```json
   118	{"service":"driftlens","status":"ok"}
   119	{"checks":{"configuration":"pass","persistence":"pass"},"issues":[],"service":"driftlens","status":"ready"}
   120	{"buildSha":"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567","service":"driftlens"}
   121	```
   122	
   123	Readiness failures return `503`, set `status` to `not_ready`, set the
   124	configuration or persistence check to `fail`, and report only safe issue codes:
   125	
   126	Each readiness request performs a rolled-back SQLite write probe. The probe
   127	verifies current write capability without retaining a scan or stage record.
   128	
   129	| Issue code                   | Action                                                    |
   130	| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
   131	| `RUNTIME_MODE_INVALID`       | Set `NODE_ENV` to `development`, `test`, or `production`  |
   132	| `BUILD_SHA_REQUIRED`         | Inject a full commit SHA when building a production app   |
   133	| `BUILD_SHA_INVALID`          | Use exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters           |
   134	| `DATA_DIR_INVALID`           | Use an absolute, null-byte-free production data directory |
   135	| `GITHUB_REPOSITORY_REQUIRED` | Configure one public GitHub `owner/repository`            |
   136	| `GITHUB_REPOSITORY_INVALID`  | Use a valid GitHub `owner/repository` identifier          |
   137	| `MANIFEST_PATH_REQUIRED`     | Configure one relative Deployment YAML path               |
   138	| `MANIFEST_PATH_INVALID`      | Remove absolute, empty, dot, or parent segments           |
   139	| `KUBECONFIG_PATH_REQUIRED`   | Configure an absolute kubeconfig path                     |
   140	| `KUBECONFIG_PATH_INVALID`    | Use an absolute, null-byte-free path                      |
   141	| `KUBECONTEXT_INVALID`        | Use a bounded context without control characters          |
   142	| `CONFIGURATION_INVALID`      | Verify the configured kubeconfig is readable and valid    |
   143	| `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`        | Verify the data directory and SQLite file are writable    |
   144	
   145	Local development defaults to build version `development`. Production requires
   146	`DRIFTLENS_BUILD_SHA` at build time as a lowercase, full 40-character Git SHA.
   147	The value is embedded during `next build` and cannot be changed through the
   148	runtime environment. A missing or invalid production value leaves health
   149	successful but makes readiness fail.
   150	
   151	`NODE_ENV` must be exactly `development`, `test`, or `production`. A missing or
   152	unknown value leaves liveness successful but fails readiness with the safe
   153	`RUNTIME_MODE_INVALID` code.
   154	
   155	`DRIFTLENS_DATA_DIR` selects the directory containing the current
   156	`driftlens.sqlite` scan-history database. It defaults to `.driftlens` locally
   157	and `/data` in production. A production override must be an absolute path.
   158	
   159	## Quality gates
   160	
   161	```bash
   162	npm run verify
   163	```
   164	
   165	The command runs formatting, lint, strict type checking, unit coverage,
   166	production build, production-dependency audit, and a bounded secret-pattern
   167	scan. Unit tests do not use the network.
   168	
   169	Individual commands are also available:
   170	
   171	```bash
   172	npm run format:check
   173	npm run lint
   174	npm run typecheck
   175	npm run test
   176	npm run test:coverage
   177	npm run test:scanner
   178	npm run build
   179	npm run audit
   180	npm run secret:scan
   181	```
   182	
   183	## Production container
   184	
   185	Build with the exact source revision:
   186	
   187	```bash
   188	docker build \
   189	  --build-arg DRIFTLENS_BUILD_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
   190	  -t driftlens:"$(git rev-parse HEAD)" .
   191	```
   192	
   193	Run with a persistent data volume:
   194	
   195	```bash
   196	docker run --rm \
   197	  --publish 3000:3000 \
   198	  --volume driftlens-data:/data \
   199	  --volume /absolute/path/to/read-only.kubeconfig:/run/secrets/driftlens-kubeconfig:ro \
   200	  --env DRIFTLENS_GITHUB_REPOSITORY=owner/public-repository \
   201	  --env DRIFTLENS_MANIFEST_PATH=path/to/deployment.yaml \
   202	  --env DRIFTLENS_KUBECONFIG_PATH=/run/secrets/driftlens-kubeconfig \
   203	  driftlens:"$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
   204	```
   205	
   206	The final image runs as an unprivileged user. Validate it with:
   207	
   208	```bash
   209	curl --fail http://localhost:3000/api/health
   210	curl --fail http://localhost:3000/api/ready
   211	curl --fail http://localhost:3000/api/version
   212	```
   213	
   214	The versioned private-target bootstrap, release, smoke, and rollback contract
   215	is documented in [docs/delivery.md](docs/delivery.md).
   216	
   217	## Current limitations
   218	
   219	- One configured public GitHub source and one Deployment per application
   220	  instance.
   221	- One active in-process scan; no concurrency, cancellation, automatic retry,
   222	  overall workflow timeout, or restart resumability.
   223	- Replicas and regular-container images only.
   224	- Read-only namespaced Deployment lookup only; no list, watch, or write.
   225	- No operator scan UI yet.
   226	- No AI explanation yet.
   227	- No private Git, configuration CRUD, live `kind` proof, or infrastructure
   228	  changes in this slice.
   229	
   230	Implementation follows the official
   231	[Next.js `after()` contract](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/after),
   232	[GitHub commit](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/commits/commits#get-a-commit)
   233	and
   234	[repository-content](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/contents#get-repository-content)
   235	APIs, the
   236	[Kubernetes JavaScript client](https://github.com/kubernetes-client/javascript),
   237	and [Node SQLite](https://nodejs.org/api/sqlite.html).
   238	
   239	See [the PRD](docs/PRD.md), [architecture overview](docs/architecture.md), and
   240	[AI evidence procedure](docs/ai-interaction-evidence.md).

payload.name: exec
payload.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"for f in [REDACTED: LOCAL PATH] do
  test -f "$f" || continue
  meta=$(head -n 1 "$f")
  cwd=$(printf '%s\n' "$meta" | jq -r '.payload.cwd // ""')
  case "$cwd" in *driftlens*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
  id=$(printf '%s\n' "$meta" | jq -r '.payload.id')
  source_type=$(printf '%s\n' "$meta" | jq -r '.payload.source|type')
  if test "$source_type" = object; then
    role=$(printf '%s\n' "$meta" | jq -r '.payload.source.subagent.thread_spawn.agent_path // "subagent"')
    parent=$(printf '%s\n' "$meta" | jq -r '.payload.source.subagent.thread_spawn.parent_thread_id // "-"')
  else
    role=top-level
    parent=-
  fi
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(basename "$f")" "$id" "$role" "$parent" "$cwd"
done","workdir":"[REDACTED: LOCAL PATH]","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output);
